metadata.description: Postemi (postemi.com): write, schedule and publish social media posts from Cursor.

plugins.name: postemi
plugins.description: Write, schedule and publish social media posts to 25+ platforms through Postemi's MCP server, and announce releases from your changelog.

plugins.name: postemi-growth
plugins.description: Optional Postemi skill: grow an audience on social media. Choosing networks and a first niche, a 30-day posting test, cadence per network, reading the numbers, 30 post angles for one topic, repurposing, bios and profile links, and a weekly review. Install it next to the Postemi plugin (MCP or CLI), which schedules the posts.
